# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this repository, please report it privately.

**DO NOT open a public issue.**

Contact: admin@local (PGP encrypted preferred)

## Response Timeline
- Acknowledgment: within 48 hours
- Initial assessment: within 7 days
- Fix or mitigation: depends on severity

## Scope
All custom code in this repository. Third-party dependencies should be reported to their respective maintainers.
